zheng-xuan.oneLineEn: Eastern Han classics master who synthesized New and Old Text learning into a commentary system.

zongmi.oneLineEn: Tang fifth Huayan patriarch and Chan-doctrine mediator joining panjiao with three-teachings comparison.
keywordsEn: Preface to the Collection on the Sources of Chan
Inquiry into the Origin of Humanity

abhinavagupta.oneLineEn: Kashmir Śaiva and Indian aesthetics master linking religious metaphysics to the rasa tradition.

abraham-abulafia.oneLineEn: Prophetic/ecstatic Kabbalist known for letter combination, divine-name meditation, and prophecy theory.

abraham-ibn-daud.oneLineEn: Author of The Exalted Faith; a key pre-Maimonidean node of Jewish Aristotelianism.

abraham-joshua-heschel.oneLineEn: Twentieth-century Jewish theologian joining awe, prophetic ethics, and experience to justice.

abu-bakr-al-razi.oneLineEn: Physician-philosopher and freethinker known for rational naturalism and critique of religious authority.

aj-ayer.oneLineEn: Main British voice of logical positivism; bridges the Vienna Circle to Anglo-American analysis.

aksapada-gautama.oneLineEn: Traditional author of the Nyāya Sūtra; source of Nyāya logic and epistemology.

al-afghani.oneLineEn: Pan-Islamic activist and early modernist shaping anti-colonial, reformist Muslim public politics.

al-ashari.oneLineEn: Founder of Ashʿarism who reshaped rational theology between anti-Muʿtazilism and Sunni doctrine.

al-baqillani.oneLineEn: Ashʿarī systematizer known for doctrinal proofs, atomistic time, and Qurʾānic inimitability.

al-hallaj.oneLineEn: Sufi of 'I am the Truth' and martyrdom; node of mystical union and conflict with religious authority.

al-junayd.oneLineEn: Core of Baghdad's sober Sufism; disciplined expression between mystical experience and law.

al-juwayni.oneLineEn: Imām al-Ḥaramayn, teacher of al-Ghazālī; strengthened demonstration in Ashʿarī theology and uṣūl.

al-maturidi.oneLineEn: Founder of Māturīdism; Sunni theology of reason, revelation, and responsibility in a Ḥanafī frame.

alain-locke.oneLineEn: Harlem Renaissance and value-pluralism figure filling African American philosophical tradition.

alberdi.oneLineEn: Argentine liberal and constitutional thinker who set nation-building as American philosophy's task.

alejandro-korn.oneLineEn: Argentine anti-positivist who reframed philosophy around creative freedom and value.

alexandre-kojeve.oneLineEn: Key French interpreter of Hegel's Phenomenology; prehistory of existentialism and post-structuralism.
